create_mixup_util: create a MixupUtil instance with a given batch size to prepare mixup augmentation
mixup_tensor: use MixupUtil mixup method to linearly interpolate a batch of input tensors
mixup_labels: use MixupUtil mixup_labels method to shuffle and mixup target labels by batch indices
compute_mixup_loss: use MixupUtil compute_loss to calculate weighted loss between original and mixed targets
get_lambda_beta: use MixupUtil _get_lambda to sample a mixing coefficient from a beta distribution
